# ASA Supplies

> > Industrial safety equipment and PPE supplier specializing in cold storage gear, hearing protection, work gloves, and high-visibility apparel for workplace safety compliance.

ASA Supplies (ASA, LLC) provides comprehensive personal protective equipment (PPE) and industrial safety supplies for manufacturing, construction, food processing, and cold storage environments. The company offers products from leading brands including 3M, Ansell, Cordova, and AlphaTec, with emphasis on ANSI, OSHA, FDA, and CSA compliance standards.

## Key Topics

- Industrial Safety & PPE
- ANSI Class E High-Visibility Apparel
- 3M Hearing Protection (NRR ratings)
- Ansell & Foam Nitrile Work Gloves
- Cold Storage & Freezer Wear
- OSHA & FDA Compliance
- Anti-Vibration & Cut-Resistant Gloves
- Disposable Cleanroom Apparel
- Chemical-Resistant Gloves (EN 374)
- Waterproof & Reflective Workwear
- Noise Reduction & Earmuffs
- Hand Protection & Abrasion Resistance
- ComfortSafe Product Line
- CSA Class AL Standards
